title: Do Language Models Know Their Slang? Queer Slang Understanding in User-Generated Content

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models' ability to understand and define community-specific sociolects (queer slang) from user-generated content through a definition generation task, measured using ROUGE-L, BERTScore, and manual qualitative analysis.
Assessing LLMs' knowledge of LGBTQIA+ identity labels, reclaimed terms, and idioms to identify representational gaps and cisheteronormative defaults when processing polysemous terms.
